random_uniform.label: uniform random (trades more; not the GATE-LEARN null)

curves.semantics: OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST SEGMENTS ONLY: dates[i] is the session whose close marks point i; point 0 is the first test decision (equity 1.0). Each fold's episode starts flat at equity 1.0 and is chain-linked onto the previous fold's final equity (no cost at the boundary; the next fold pays its own entry). The HEADLINE band (headline_band) is random_matched_* — turnover-matched random (the GATE-LEARN null): the null GATE-LEARN failed to beat; the agent line beating a uniform-random band is NOT evidence of learning. agent_seeds_min/max shade all agent seeds; the agent line is ONE of them. Train/val/purge appear ONLY as 'background' spans (no values)

series.agent: exhibit seed 0's per-fold PPO policies (ONE seed; see meta.exhibit_rank)
series.agent_seeds_max: pointwise maximum over all 5 agent seeds' stitched curves; the exhibit line ends at the TOP of this envelope at every cost (it is the best final equity of the seeds)
series.agent_seeds_min: pointwise minimum over all 5 agent seeds' stitched curves (the shaded 5-seed envelope's floor)
series.buy_and_hold: BUY at each fold's first decision, then HOLD
series.random_matched_p25: turnover-matched random (the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise 25th percentile over 30 chain-linked seeds; in each fold the random policy trades with the agent's own per-fold trade rate (rl-07 matched_trade_probability over its 5 seeds), seed s = random.Random(s) — exactly rl-10's random_matched[ppo]
series.random_matched_p50: turnover-matched random (the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise median
series.random_matched_p75: turnover-matched random (the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise 75th percentile
series.random_uniform_p25: uniform random (trades more; not the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise 25th percentile over 30 chain-linked uniform (1/3 trade probability) seeds — rl-10's random
series.random_uniform_p50: uniform random (trades more; not the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise median
series.random_uniform_p75: uniform random (trades more; not the GATE-LEARN null): pointwise 75th percentile
series.sma_cross_20_50: long iff SMA_20 > SMA_50 of the trailing closes

notes: val windows are unused: training is the fixed-budget rl-08 configuration (no early stopping / model selection), so no validation number exists to quote
ppo_untrained = each seed's PPO at initialization (total_timesteps=0), retrained and exported per fold through the identical path; it separates 'PPO learned' from 'the env is trivially profitable'
GATE-LEARN null = the random policy TURNOVER-MATCHED per fold to the agent (rl-07 matched_trade_probability); 'random' rows are the uniform (1/3) baseline
risk_clipped_fraction is None (n/a on this path, NOT 0%): the Tier B env path has no RiskGate, so nothing was measured

corr(bh) is determined by exposure here; no timing information: corr(bh) is a closed-form function of exposure for 0/1 position paths, so it is not independent evidence of anything exposure does not already show

IQM CIs are two-stage bootstraps (folds resampled, then seeds within each drawn fold); for a policy with one run per fold the inner stage is a no-op, so it carries a fold-only CI of the same estimator (recomputed by rl-12 from the report's per-fold rows; see bundle_notes). The gates read the fold-clustered CR0 SE with t(K-1) [rl-12: replaces the report's note, which predates those CIs]

arithmetic: SMA_n = left-to-right float sum of the last n closes C_{t-n+1}..C_t, divided by n
vol_21 = SAMPLE standard deviation (divide by 20) of the 21 log returns ln(C_i / C_{i-1}), i = t-20..t: mean = left-to-right sum / 21; variance = left-to-right sum of squared deviations / 20; sqrt
every value is clipped to [obs_low, obs_high], then rounded to float32 (Math.fround) before the forward pass — the exact inputs the policy was trained and parity-checked on
entry_close = the close at which the open position was FILLED (bar t_buy + 1), never the decision bar's close
ln/tanh are not bit-identical across libm/V8 (~1 ulp): compare with a tolerance

definitions.formula: 1.0 if a position is held else 0.0
definitions.name: held

execution.cost_model: flat one-way bps of traded notional, charged on every fill (trading.rl.costs; scale-free, never a price level)
execution.equity_step: E_{t+1} = E_t * ((1 + p_t * (C_{t+1} / C_t - 1)) * (1 - (bps * 1e-4) * |p_{t+1} - p_t|)), p_t held over t->t+1, p_{t+1} after the fill at C_{t+1}
execution.fill: an accepted BUY/SELL decided at bar t fills at the close of bar t+1
execution.fold_reset: each fold's episode starts flat at equity 1.0; stitched curves chain-link the per-fold episodes
execution.legality: BUY only when flat, SELL only when long; anything else is a HOLD no-op

meta.exhibit_label: exhibit seed 0: ONE training seed's per-fold policies, each deciding only its own fold's out-of-sample test window (stitched). It is the best of 5 seeds on this span (rank 1 of 5 by stitched final equity at every cost; meta.exhibit_rank), so it flatters the agent. It is an illustration, not the result: every statistic in eval_table is the 5-seed, fold-clustered distribution over 21 folds

exhibit_rank.by: stitched final equity = product of the seed's per-fold final_equity rows; mean per-fold sharpe; both from the evaluation report's rows (rank 1 = best)

float_formats.f32: shortest decimal (1..9 significant digits) that parses back to the same float32; LOSSLESS for float32 values — recover the exact value with Math.fround(parsed)
float_formats.f32-b64: an array of n float32 values: little-endian bytes, byte-plane shuffled (byte 0 of every value, then byte 1, byte 2, byte 3; value i's byte j is at offset j * n + i), then standard padded base64 (RFC 4648). LOSSLESS. Matrices are row-major [out][in]
float_formats.sig6: rounded to 6 significant digits (display only: replay probabilities, curve bands and the seed envelope)
float_formats.writer: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False, ensure_ascii=True) + '\n' (UTF-8); deterministic: equal inputs => equal bytes

policies_shipped.precision: full: the exact float32 weights of every exhibit-seed fold policy (f32-b64, lossless)

meta.price_basis: Alpaca adjustment=all: split- and dividend-adjusted (total-return) closes as served by Alpaca at generated_at; may reflect later corrections. Ratios of closes are PIT-correct; absolute levels before later dividends are back-adjusted (current-vintage), NOT as-traded prices. Use closes only as ratios of closes.
meta.price_label: dividend-adjusted (total-return) closes as served by Alpaca on 2026-10-22T02:14:43.134336Z; may reflect later corrections

architecture.forward: each unit = (left-to-right sum over j of weight[i][j] * x[j]) + bias[i], then the activation (tanh / identity); logits = action_head(hidden...(obs)); action = actions[argmax(logits)], an exact tie resolving to the LOWEST index; never sampled. action_probs = softmax: m = max(logits); e_i = exp(l_i - m); p_i = e_i / (left-to-right sum of e)

policy.parity_semantics: observation (f32) -> logits/probs (exact float64, computed by trading.domain.rl_policy from the exact weights) and argmax; the page's forward pass must match argmax exactly and logits within a tolerance (tanh/exp ~1 ulp)

replay.semantics: one record per TEST decision bar: action = the policy's argmax (requested), effective = after the legality rule (BUY only when flat, SELL only when long; else a HOLD no-op), position = held at decision time (fills at closes <= date). An accepted order fills at the NEXT session's close. fold_index names the policy (policy.policies[].fold_index) that decided it; each fold starts flat
